title: Synthesizing hyperspectral Data using generative Models to train spectral Unmixing Methods for low-cost Crop Residue Cover Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2611.24827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The spectral range of the Field Imaging Nanosatellite for Crop residue Hyperspectral Mapping (FINCH), developed by the University of Toronto Aerospace Team's Space System Division, poses significant challenges for hyperspectral unmixing to determine crop residue cover fractional abundances. The severe lack of standard indices necessitates the use of complex, data-driven unmixing models. Complex unmixing models require dense, well-distributed manifolds, whereas ground-truth datasets are sparse and expensive. To better leverage the information content in existing ground-truth datasets, this study presents a framework that decouples interpolation and abundance-mapping estimation via an intermediary conditional data generator, contrasting with traditional single-model unmixing pipelines. translated_title: 利用生成模型合成高光谱数据以训练光谱解混方法，实现低成本作物残茬覆盖制图
translated_abstract: 由多伦多大学航空航天团队空间系统分部开发的作物残茬高光谱制图田间成像纳卫星（FINCH）的光谱范围，给通过高光谱解混确定作物残茬覆盖丰度分数带来了重大挑战。标准指标的严重缺乏使得必须使用复杂的、数据驱动的解混模型。复杂的解混模型需要密集且分布良好的流形，而地面真值数据集稀疏且昂贵。为了更好地利用现有地面真值数据集中的信息内容，本研究提出了一个框架，通过一个中间条件数据生成器将插值与丰度制图估计解耦，这与传统的单一模型解混流程形成对比。这种解耦使得能够纳入关于光谱的物理先验知识，而这些知识是解混模型本身无法获得的，从而人为地……
tldr: 本研究提出通过中间条件数据生成器将插值与丰度估计解耦的框架，利用生成模型合成高光谱数据来训练解混模型，从而在地面真值数据稀疏的条件下实现低成本的作物残茬覆盖制图。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a framework that decouples interpolation and abundance-mapping estimation via an intermediary conditional data generator, using generative models to synthesize hyperspectral data for training unmixing methods, enabling low-cost crop residue cover mapping despite sparse ground-truth datasets.
